text:
Sam S.: passing IvyCare (mid-market healthcare analytics) to CS — contract signed 3/1, go-live target 6 weeks. Key context: PHI dataset (HIPAA), customer prefers private deployment but will pilot hosted first, SSO via Okta, expected traffic ~180–220 req/min, spikey during business hours. Renewal in 11 months, legal asked for BAA; finance committed to quarterly consumption review. :wave:

Sam S.: quick TL;DR config: ```
SSO: Okta (SAML)
Redirect: https://app.ivycare.prod/redirect
Data residency: US-East (preferred)
Throughput: 200 req/min (95th)
Model: initially open-llm-v2-small, may upgrade to v2-medium after perf checks
Private eval: yes — may need on-prem connector for PHI later
```

Priya C.: thanks — picking this up. I'll schedule a kickoff this week with IvyCare PM and our enablement lead. Can someone confirm who from sales will join handoff call? Also we should note: legal/BAA in progress, confirm expected date.

Sam S.: I can join call Tue 9am PT. Legal expects BAA signed by next week (they sent draft yesterday). Finance/Proc will need invoice contact: emma@ivycare.com.

Diego K.: re: private eval & infra — please open a Support ticket with label `private-eval` and include environment size request. For PHI, we'll need to run through the security checklist: KMS, VPC peering, audit logs. Template below to paste into ticket: ```
Customer: IvyCare
Deployment: Private eval (US-East)
Min GPU: 2 x A100 or equivalent
SLOs: p95 latency < 250ms, throughput 200rpm
Compliance: HIPAA / BAA required
Contacts: emma@ivycare.com (finance), lucas@ivycare.com (tech)
```

Maya L.: from Solutions — note that open-llm-v2-small may not meet latency at 200rpm with long contexts. Recommend running perf test on hosted first and parallel a dedicated pool sizing estimate. I'll draft the model/quantization options and an early perf plan. Also flagging integration for SSO redirect domains (they use multiple subdomains).

Priya C.: Risk notes: renewal okay (11mo) but medium risk if PHI deployment drags >8 weeks. Also user adoption risk — no in-house ML ops team; require strong enablement + runbook. Action items below. :memo:

Priya C.: ACTIONS:
- Priya: schedule kickoff + invite Sam, Maya, Diego, IvyCare PM (target Tue 9am PT)
- Sam: drop BAA draft and finance contact into #private-contracts by EOD
- Diego: open Support ticket `private-eval` and kick off security checklist (ETA 48h)
- Maya: provide perf test plan and sizing recommendations (ETA 3 business days)
- OnboardingBot: create onboarding checklist for IvyCare (SSO, sample data flow, runbook)

OnboardingBot: Created checklist #ONB-4521 and assigned to Priya C., Diego K., Maya L. — https://redwood.internal/onboarding/ONB-4521

Sam S.: thanks all — IvyCare PM Lucas is responsive. I'll loop him into calendar invite. :thumbsup:

Diego K.: note for Support/Eng: if private eval moves to on-prem later we'll need a dedicated infra design review — tagging @eng-architecture after perf results.

Priya C.: closing loop here — I'll post meeting notes and owners after kickoff. If anything blocks before then drop in this thread.

Maya L.: uploaded initial perf checklist to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/ivycare/perf-checklist — will update after tests.

Sam S.: added billing PO number to #private-contracts (PO-88921).

Priya C.: last: immediate blocker = BAA signature. Sam, can you confirm once signed so we can proceed with data access?

Sam S.: will confirm — expect signed by Friday.

Diego K.: noted. I'll wait for Support ticket to start infra prep.

Priya C.: thanks everyone. :sparkles:
